commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
echo 'BASELINE_C6=/dev/cu.usbmodem101 SERIAL=40:4C:CA:5D:0A:00 LOCATION=0-1 VIDPID=303A:1001'
echo '=== PYSerial current ==='
python3 - <<'PY'
from serial.tools import list_ports
for p in sorted(list_ports.comports(), key=lambda x: x.device):
    print(f'DEVICE={p.device} DESC={p.description} HWID={p.hwid} VID={p.vid} PID={p.pid} SERIAL={p.serial_number} LOCATION={p.location} MANUFACTURER={p.manufacturer} PRODUCT={p.product}')
print('=== Espressif candidates ===')
for p in sorted(list_ports.comports(), key=lambda x: x.device):
    if p.vid == 0x303A or (p.manufacturer and 'Espressif' in p.manufacturer):
        marker = 'BASELINE' if p.device == '/dev/cu.usbmodem101' and p.serial_number == '40:4C:CA:5D:0A:00' else 'NEW_CANDIDATE'
        print(f'{marker} DEVICE={p.device} VIDPID={p.vid:04X}:{p.pid:04X} SERIAL={p.serial_number} LOCATION={p.location} PRODUCT={p.product}')
PY
